title: Kabedo me tedo ki yubu gin acama, ki joo ma gi woto awota katedo ki yubu gin acama. - Uganda Revenue Authority

headers: Kare ma yub man twero tic
Ngo mamite wek inong kony ite yub man
rows: Lucul mucoro ma gucone pi culu mucoro VAT
Dano wen magucone pi mucoro VAT gitwero penyo pi jami ducu magutiyo kwede ikare me yubu jami acata.

Wel cente ma biacara nongo maromo million miya acel ki pyera abic (150,000,000), ikin kare moo keken maromo dwe apar wiye aryo pi tyen me acel ma en ocone kwede, kero me gwoko kor tic/rekod me biacara ikare ducu,  ki miyo jami acata ma twero culu mocoro.
